test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following can be a suitable title for the given passage?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage covers a wide range of events leading up to the Russian Revolution, including multiple wars, the plight of peasants, the rise of the industrial working class, and the leadership of Tsar Nicholas II.
 
• While aspects of 'Option 1', 'Option 3' and 'Option 4' are mentioned, none of them cover the entirety of the passage's scope.
 
• 'Option 2' - "The Russian Revolution", on the other hand, provides a broad title that encompasses all of the topics discussed in the passage - the wars, the plight of peasants and workers, and the failings of Tsar Nicholas II, which all contributed to the revolution.

Therefore, the correct answer is - **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• 'Option 1' (The industrial working class) only considers one aspect of the revolution.
 
• 'Option 3' (Shortcomings of Tsar Nicholas II) although significant, fails to capture the other contributing causes to the revolution.
 
• 'Option 4' (The Wars Russia Fought) while relevant to the buildup of the Revolution, does not cover the other important factors discussed in the passage.
